cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Hope Keeps Moving
cards.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The hall rejected our wedding booking. Remember when I made you revise a plan instead of throwing it away? We're finding somewhere better.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every venue is booked for June.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then September. You always rushed to hand things in; three more months will do us good.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My parents can't travel in September.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we go to them. Their garden. You can stop treating every correction as a failure—we're getting closer to the wedding we actually want.

reason: Give familiar coaching habits a concrete function in A pursuit. Preserve legible stakes and partner contributions; where source interaction is unspecified, establish a specific topic rather than rely on charitable backstory.
